caption:
Ep 2: The 10K Bet 💸

67,569 saved reels. 24 hours. One mate who doesn't think he can do it.

Spot Sorty before he talks. Comment the second you first saw him 👀

Sort your own saved reels free: download your Instagram data (tick only Saved), drop the zip into savesortai.com. It runs in your browser, nothing gets uploaded. Link in bio.

It's a skit: the bet and the 67,569 are made up. The report on the laptop is our real sample report. The voices are AI.
